items.question: How is Cardynal different from Intercom or Zendesk?
items.answer: They're helpdesks with AI bolted on. Cardynal is AI-native — built from the ground up with a visual workflow engine (28+ node types), multi-LLM support (OpenAI + Anthropic), and a zero-code integration marketplace. All at a fraction of the price.

items.question: Is this for agencies or end users?
items.answer: Both. Agencies and freelancers deploy AI support for their clients from a single workspace. SMBs with 20+ employees use it directly. Multi-workspace management is built in.

items.question: What happens when the AI can't answer?
items.answer: It escalates to a human with full context. Your team gets a notification and picks up the conversation in the same inbox. The customer sees no interruption.

items.question: Do I need a developer?
items.answer: No. Everything is visual — drag-and-drop agent canvas, workflow builder, and integration marketplace. We also offer guided onboarding if you want help.

items.question: Which channels are included?
items.answer: Web chat, email (Gmail), Instagram, Messenger, and API are included in every plan. WhatsApp (Meta Cloud API or QR code) is included from the Growth plan upwards. No per-message fees on any channel.

items.question: Do you support voice / phone agents? (Coming soon)
items.answer: Voice AI agents for inbound and outbound phone calls are on the roadmap and coming soon. They'll work the same way as our chat agents — detect intent, run the right playbook, escalate to a human with full context when needed — but over the phone. Want early access? Talk to us.

items.question: How does pricing work?
items.answer: Flat monthly fee with clear quotas — sessions, agents, inboxes, sources, workflows. No per-resolution charges. Start with a 14-day free trial, upgrade when you're ready. Cancel anytime.

items.question: What use cases does Cardynal cover?
items.answer: SaaS support, e-commerce (order tracking, returns), booking & appointments, insurance claims, professional services — any business that handles customer conversations at scale.

items.question: What LLMs are supported?
items.answer: OpenAI (GPT-4) and Anthropic (Claude). Choose per agent, switch anytime. Embeddings use OpenAI for consistent vector search across your knowledge base.

comingSoon.title: AI voice agents for inbound and outbound calls.
comingSoon.description: The same agent brain you build for chat — now answering the phone. Detect intent on a live call, run the right playbook, transfer to a human with the full transcript when needed. Low-latency, multilingual, on the channel that still drives most revenue.
